purpose: Stop pitching only the $2,500 survival proof. Give every outreach lane exact alternate Muhlnickel inference pitches with honest conversion routes.

truth.note: These are channel-ready pitches, not live marketplace listings and not cash claims.

pitches.subject: 10M generated tokens for $1 on Muhlnickel
pitches.one_sentence: If you are paying cloud output rates, Muhlnickel sells 10 million generated tokens for $1 on an already-connected model with a written capacity window and a full refund if no window is offered within seven days.
pitches.cta: Reply with the model family you need capacity for and a public contact URL.

pitches.subject: 100M generated tokens for $5 — 75% below cited cloud output floor
pitches.one_sentence: 100 million generated tokens for $5 ($0.05/M) undercuts the lowest cited published cloud output rate without claiming model-quality equivalence.
pitches.cta: Reply with volume, context limit, and the already-connected model you want named in writing before checkout.

pitches.subject: 1B generated tokens for $20 on Muhlnickel
pitches.one_sentence: One billion generated tokens for $20 ($0.02/M) is a prepaid capacity credit on an already-connected Muhlnickel model, receipted by tokenizer count and run hashes.
pitches.cta: Reply with the generation task class and your public contact URL.

pitches.subject: One attested Muhlnickel inference run — $500
pitches.one_sentence: Send one public or non-confidential model task and an exact evaluation rule; for $500 you get outputs, hashes, timing, substrate identity, and reconstruction instructions from an owner-local Muhlnickel run.
pitches.cta: Send the task for scope confirmation.

pitches.subject: Evaluated Muhlnickel batch — $1,500
pitches.one_sentence: Up to three prompt variants scored against one buyer-supplied rubric, with the same attested evidence bundle as the $500 run.
pitches.cta: Send the rubric and the three candidate prompts.

pitches.subject: Bespoke attested compute job — $2,500
pitches.one_sentence: One bounded inference or general-compute job with a bespoke evidence bundle — distinct from the Same-Day Agent Survival Proof, which is a production-failure rescue product.
pitches.cta: Send the binary acceptance rule and delivery window.

pitches.subject: Buyer-side fit only — Upwork LLM cost spike brief
pitches.one_sentence: An active Upwork brief reports OpenAI spend rising from $2,140 to $13,890 while usage rose about 40%; that pain fits a bounded Muhlnickel cost/capacity audit, not a fabricated acceptance.
pitches.cta: Do not submit until an authorized Upwork account exists; keep the brief as fit evidence and route replies to attested-inference.html.

do_not: Pitch only the $2,500 survival proof when the buyer pain is token cost or a single attested run.
Invent a Shopify storefront URL or Stripe Payment Link.
Claim model-quality equivalence to Gemini, GPT, or Claude.
Claim a customer, payment, or cash event.
